package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_logging_overhead_per_record_debug_log_in_batch: Layer: Logging overhead. Flag debug logging per batch record on hot ingestion paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario563Positive(records []string) {
	// Emits a Debug-level log per record inside a batch processing loop.
	// Even if Debug is disabled, log call arguments may be evaluated,
	// and per-record logging in hot ingestion paths adds unnecessary
	// overhead at scale.
	for _, record := range records {
		slog.Debug("processing record", slog.String("item", record))
		processRecord563(record)
	}
}
